nodes.name: Document Triggered
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/vendor-onboarding/document with {document_id, action, case_id, metadata}. action is 'process' or 'reprocess'.

nodes.name: Workflow Settings
nodes.notes: Only place configuration is declared. The secret is read from the container environment by expression so it is never written into this workflow file.

nodes.name: Validate Trigger
nodes.notes: Rejects a malformed trigger before it can build a URL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({event_type: 'DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_DISPATCHED', case_id: Number($json.case_id), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: Object.assign({_workflow: $workflow.name, _execution_id: $execution.id}, ({action: $json.action, trigger_metadata: $json.trigger_metadata}))}) }}

nodes.name: Record Trigger Started
nodes.notes: Records DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_DISPATCHED in the case audit trail.

nodes.name: Process Document
nodes.notes: Runs classification and extraction. Retries on transient failure.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({event_type: 'RETRY_EXHAUSTED', case_id: Number($('Validate Trigger').first().json.case_id), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: Object.assign({_workflow: $workflow.name, _execution_id: $execution.id}, ({stage: 'document_processing', detail: 'Document processing call failed after 3 attempts.'}))}) }}

nodes.name: Record Process Failure
nodes.notes: Terminal. Reached only after retries are spent.

nodes.name: Interpret Process
nodes.notes: Maps the synchronous processing response to a state.

nodes.name: Processing Ok?
nodes.notes: A processing failure (not a 409, not a 404) is terminal.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({event_type: 'WORKFLOW_FAILED', case_id: Number($json.case_id), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: Object.assign({_workflow: $workflow.name, _execution_id: $execution.id}, ({stage: 'document_processing', state: $json.processing_state, detail: $json.processing_detail, http_status: $json.processing_http_status}))}) }}

nodes.name: Record Processing Failed
nodes.notes: Terminal. The extraction did not succeed.

nodes.name: Verify Extraction
nodes.notes: Records human verification when extraction confidence was low.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({event_type: 'WORKFLOW_COMPLETED', case_id: Number($json.case_id), timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: Object.assign({_workflow: $workflow.name, _execution_id: $execution.id}, ({outcome: 'document_processed', document_id: $json.document_id, state: $json.processing_state, verified: $json.verification_state || 'not_required', confidence: $json.extraction_confidence, document_type: $json.document_type, fields_extracted: Object.keys($json.extracted_fields || {}).length}))}) }}

nodes.name: Record Document Complete
nodes.notes: Terminal success. Document processed and optionally verified.

parameters.content:
## Vendor Onboarding — Document Intake

Triggered when a document is uploaded or a reviewer clicks Re-process.

**This workflow contains no extraction logic.** It posts to the document service, retries transient failures, and records the outcome.

A document that does not meet confidence thresholds is flagged for human verification on the document detail page, not reprocessed automatically.
